es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Drake Sued Over ‘Janice STFU’ by Producer Who Says Rapper Stole His Chorus
items.summary: Drake enfrenta una demanda por infracción de derechos de autor sobre su canción “Janice STFU”, presentada por el productor Aviel Calev Hirschfield, quien alega que el rapero utilizó su coro sin el reconocimiento adecuado y afirma que la pista incorpora su contribución sustancial.

items.title: Sony and Universal Demand DistroKid AI Music Upload Data in Copyright Battle
items.summary: Sony y Universal exigen que DistroKid proporcione datos sobre las subidas de música generada por IA como parte de una disputa de derechos de autor, buscando transparencia sobre cómo la plataforma gestiona composiciones de inteligencia artificial.

items.title: Atlantic/WMG Sues Ray-Ban Owner Luxottica, Demands Over $64 Million in Damages as Social Media Infringement Crackdown Continues
items.summary: The social media copyright crackdown continues: Warner Music Group (WMG) is now suing multiple subsidiaries of eyewear giant EssilorLuxottica for allegedly infringing on north of 400 compositions and recordings in Instagram and TikTok posts. items.title: Can We Sue Our Way to AI Control?
items.summary: The labels want their power back. Copyright needs to be rebuilt. There is a comforting version of the AI music story in which the record labels sue, the technology companies pay, and musicians emerge with their rights intact. The lawyers finish arguing, the executives shake hands, and somebody issues a statement about…

items.title: La legislación sobre derechos de autor tiene dificultades para adaptarse a la música creada con inteligencia artificial en Corea del Sur.
RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. The RIAA presents both as "additional" areas of concern, not as offic…

items.title: Publishing body ICMP blasts potential AI rules in Australia
items.summary: Australia’s government is currently devising its future policies on AI, training and copyright. We recently reported on labels body ARIA’s boss Annabelle Herd’s testimony at a select-committee hearing as part of that process. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Musixmatch acquires Songdex and Blokur owner Music Reports
items.summary: Lyrics firm Musixmatch was founded 16 years ago, but has never bought another company… until now. It has announced the acquisition of Music Reports, the US firm that owns the Songdex copyright registry as well as rights and licensing firm Blokur. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Deezer permitirá ocultar la música hecha con IA al buscar
items.summary: Deezer permitirá a sus usuarios ocultar la música generada íntegramente con inteligencia artificial. La plataforma francesa ha anunciado un interruptor que, una vez activado, excluirá de los resultados de búsqueda las canciones, los álbumes y los artistas vinculados a contenido 100% sintético. items.title: Corea del Sur busca una solución de "música con IA legal" mediante el seguimiento de los derechos de autor.
Sony and Universal ask court to force Suno investor Lightspeed to testify about the ‘legal risk of training data’
items.summary: The labels made their case in a filing in Boston federal court last Tuesday (October 13), opposing Lightspeed's motion to quash their subpoena. Source

tip.title: Guarda evidencia de la fecha de creación
tip.body: Un correo a ti mismo con el archivo adjunto, un repositorio con historial o un servicio de sellado de tiempo cuestan poco y construyen una línea de tiempo defendible.

en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: Drake Sued Over ‘Janice STFU’ by Producer Who Says Rapper Stole His Chorus
items.summary: Drake faces a copyright infringement lawsuit over his song “Janice STFU,” filed by producer Aviel Calev Hirschfield, who alleges the rapper used his chorus without proper acknowledgment and claims the track incorporates his substantial contribution.

items.title: Sony and Universal Demand DistroKid AI Music Upload Data in Copyright Battle
items.summary: Sony and Universal are demanding that DistroKid provide data on uploads of AI-generated music as part of an ongoing copyright dispute, seeking transparency on how the platform handles artificial‑intelligence compositions.

tip.title: Keep evidence of your creation date
tip.body: An email to yourself with the file attached, a repository with history, or a timestamping service cost little and build a defensible timeline.
